title: Prove two helpers suffice and are necessary for six query targets
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Prove that two initialized helpers are both sufficient and necessary to twist six independent formal query coordinates using at most four square-zero paid calls of rank at most2. This holds over every characteristic-two field K, with formal central Q satisfying Q²=1 and constant invertible free bases.

The four-call construction has total paid rank8 and six free basis gates. Its complete eight-coordinate operator is W=[[Q I6,(1+Q)L],[0,Q I2]], L=[I2;I2;I2]. Thus W(x,0)=(Qx,0), while an arbitrary dirty helper is not restored. The one-helper trace/projection reduction turns any hypothetical smaller-helper word into the credited dirty endpoint, which requires rank9. We do not claim paid-rank8optimality or a general clean-capacity classification.

Only research/clean-two-helper-query is added. Clean preparation/ownership, charged bases, native conversion, an actual caller and the complete physical invoice remain open. All five selected assumptions remain; no supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Task and overlap

Canonical main7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a and priority revision8 were refreshed at entry and before submission without drift. The complete bit-new-register-model card is retained with explicit CHANGED/partial scope; its native conversion/full-bill gate remains unmet. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19444824).

Nick Petalas [6800](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6800), exact headc94197e40c9e8a25f643d776160659871e5ce9ac, explicitly leaves this even-target initialized-clean boundary open. Its restored-DIRTY theorem and earlier odd clean example are credited premises, not contradicted or rediscovered. Exact proof/README texts are retained with foreign-commit/Git-blob/SHA256 pins, separately from canonical provenance.

Live hub/index, all757open PR bodies/heads across eight pages, scoped helper and bounded all-state indexed searches were checked. The prepublication refresh found no source/head/body changes or source comments. Hidden/unindexed work remains unknown. 5007/5857 use idempotent reflections for a different clean coupling endpoint; 1974/2027 use different noncentral/multilabel rank-one and dirty models. No predecessor census or tariff is transferred. Prior109results and earlierB14results are excluded.

## Validation

New CPython3.12 standard-library verifier, with separately coded ordered pair-polynomial matrices and a literal component-gate interpreter. The first replay passed in1.364seconds/20.97MiB on CPython3.12.14; these are budget measurements, not a speedup claim. Both final normal/O commands and both registered commands pass with identical complete generated receipts:

- All65,536vectors of (F2[Q]/(Q²-1))^8, including4,096clean entrances, with65,536forward and65,536reverse checks and131,072round-trip compositions. The exhaustive loop executes262,144literal words; prechecks/controls add further calls.
- Every paid term is square-zero of rank2; all ten paid/free gates, the full operator and reversed word are checked.
- All64binary one-helper columns corroborate the trace/projection/shear reduction. These are not an all-word exclusion or an all-field enumeration.
- Eight intended-reason controls, six with actual unequal endpoint witnesses, cover invalid paid terms, omitted bases/normalizer/call, wrong endpoints, Q-collapse and false dirty restoration. Exhaustive-profile SHA256 aca44f95b5664b09d8baaf741721d05d8fca6bd4807b2edf837514514b4e3290.

Committed bytes/modes, canonical source history and foreign source-tree custody pass. Official export/input coverage passes; both read-only Git-free normal/O exported runs with empty PATH/PYTHONPATH reproduce the complete registered receipts, and all13archive members remain unchanged. Four source-corruption controls reject during authentication before the finite loop. The public tree equals the tested tree, with all12payload blobs bound exactly.

The all-field and minimum-helper statements rest on the written proof and credited dirty theorem, not finite tests. Source-aware proof/code/metadata reviews found no blocker; related exposure and authorship are disclosed, not blind/human/kernel acceptance. A static control-strength correction preceded the first run; the unexecuted original code and first receipt are retained. Later documentation updates changed only package-hash fields; final receipts agree. No predecessor scientific program ran.

Reproduce:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clean-two-helper-query

Expected: PASS_CLEAN_TWO_HELPER_QUERY and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE. Both original hosted checks passed on attempt1 at 518351a389e32e2ccdf0a1ca55580e9c60d65492 in [run42258713321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42258713321): plan (711helper tests,24skips) and both registered finite corroboration commands. CPython3.12.16 hosted packets are byte-for-byte equal to the complete local packets. Raw logs were retained with exact character readback. The synthetic PR test-ref has the exact public tree and canonical/public parents; this is not a repository merge. Hosted finite execution is separate from all-field proof, independent human review or proof-kernel acceptance.

Retain the distinct5007/5857 and1974/2027 lineage, classical block/trace/shear/dual-number methods, source notices and Apache-2.0 license. Provisional on-paper recipes predated the claim; no experiment ran before it.

## Open next questions

Bind one legal native caller and complete bill, including the two zero helpers, every paid map and both basis conversions. Total paid-rank optimality is a separate unsolved question; no broader search is reserved. [Proof, verifier and exact sources](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/518351a389e32e2ccdf0a1ca55580e9c60d65492/research/clean-two-helper-query).
